definition: Training set is a dataset used to train a model.
details: Training set is a dataset used to train a model. Validation set is a dataset used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a model fit on the training dataset while tuning the model's hyperparameters. Test set is a dataset used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a final model fit on the training dataset.

explainer.lead: Test sets are datasets used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a final model fit on the training set. They matter because they separate honest performance measurement from tuning.

tiers.eli5: You study with practice questions (training), check yourself with a quiz while revising (validation), then sit the real exam once at the end (test).
tiers.practitioner: Engineers hold out a test set and touch it only for the final evaluation; the validation set is used while tuning hyperparameters. A pitfall is tuning on the test set, which destroys the unbiased evaluation.
tiers.paperLevel: Training set: data used to train a model. Validation set: data used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a model fit on the training set while tuning hyperparameters. Test set: data used to provide an unbiased evaluation of a final model fit on the training set.

explainer.example: A model is trained on the training set, hyperparameters are chosen using the validation set, and final performance is reported once on the test set.
